label: OPEN reading of ST I q.7 a.1 co. for the primary p of the approach order: p's esse is received in…
paraphrase: OPEN reading of ST I q.7 a.1 co. ('esse divinum non sit esse receptum in aliquo') for the primary p of the approach order: p's esse is received in no principle. The passage says it of God; that the primary of the approach order is the one whose esse is unreceived is the analyst's.
